newsitem.title: USA: Five die in California plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Five die in California plane crash.

text.p: Five people were killed when their small plane crashed in a fireball after taking off from an airport near California's Sierra Nevada resorts, officials said on Monday.

A family of four and a 26-year-old passenger died in the crash shortly after takeoff on Sunday night from the Truckee-Tahoe Airport outside Truckee, a town 180 miles (290 km) east of San Francisco, according to a statement by the Nevada County sheriff's department.

Authorities said the plane lost speed while making a turn and slammed into the ground on the side of the runway. When rescue workers arrived at the crash site, the plane was completely engulfed in flames and the passengers were dead.
The sheriff's department identitied the victims as Jennifer Marion, 26, of San Jose, California, John and Margaret Ewert, both 64, their son Thomas, 39, and daughter Marcia, 38.
John Ewert was piloting the single-engine plane, bound for San Jose.
